recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨大的巨核細胞，細胞質豐富，核高度分葉成許多小葉團聚，細胞表面／細胞質內可見數個小型血球穿入（emperiopolesis），右側另一顆巨核細胞亦呈分葉核；大型過度分葉巨核細胞是 ET 的典型表現。
features: Giant megakaryocyte with abundant granular lilac-blue cytoplasm
Hyperlobulated nucleus composed of numerous clustered lobes
Emperiopolesis: small hematopoietic cells overlying or within the megakaryocyte cytoplasm
Second large megakaryocyte with multilobated nucleus and adherent small cells
Background of free platelet granules/platelets, granulocytes, and thick particle material
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant megakaryocyte with abundant granular cytoplasm and a markedly hyperlobulated nucleus composed of numerous clustered lobes, with emperiopolesis of small hematopoietic cells. An adjacent large megakaryocyte also shows a multilobated nucleus. Platelets are abundant in the background. Findings are consistent with the large hyperlobulated megakaryocytes of essential thrombocythemia; bone marrow biopsy and JAK2/CALR/MPL testing are needed to exclude other myeloproliferative neoplasms.

ddx.vs: PMF megakaryocytes have hyperchromatic, bulbous, cloud-like nuclei with aberrant N:C ratio, best assessed on biopsy clustering rather than aspirate.
Reactive megakaryocytes are normal in size and lobation without giant hyperlobulated forms.
Osteoclasts have multiple separate uniform round nuclei, and tumor giant cells lack platelet-type granules, unlike a single hyperlobulated megakaryocyte nucleus.
